SELECT object_id,
                                s_info_code,
                                deadline,
                                b_info_creditrating,
                                rating_value_type,
                                market_value,
                                net_assets_ratio,
                                currency_code,
                                position_type_code,
                                ann_date,
                                announce_rating_code,
                                comp_id,
                                rating_type_code,
                                opdate,
                                opmode,
                                bath_dt,
                                data_ins_time,
                                task_rs_id
							FROM ${srcdbname}.w_fundbondportfolio t where deadline 
                            between date_format(cast(from_unixtime(unix_timestamp(cast(${end_date} as string),'yyyyMMdd')) as date)-interval 6 month ,'yyyyMMdd') and cast(${end_date} as string)

preSql: delete from wd_fundbondportfolio where deadline between to_char(ADD_MONTHS(to_date(cast(${end_date} as varchar2(10)),'yyyyMMdd'),-6),'yyyyMMdd') and cast(${end_date} as varchar2(10))
